about: The world map (OpenAI image generation through Codex CLI): the region from above, without lettering; pins and routes in source/world-map.json. Original in ~/Documents/living-tabletop-world-art/.

map.prompt:
Generate one image and save it as marrow-crown--world-map.png in the current directory.

A world map for a tabletop role-playing campaign, landscape 3:2, seen straight from above like a hand-painted illustrated map (orthographic top-down view, no perspective, no horizon, no sky). A top-down illustrated cutaway map of a colossal half-living titan lying across a deep salt gorge, its bone body filling most of the picture from the left edge to the right, the roof of the body peeled away to reveal a maze of bone chambers and passages. The gorge, grey with salt, runs vertically through the left third, visible above and below the body. On the lower flank above the gorge, a closed bone seam ringed by eight white salt rings. From it a passage climbs into a hall of pale glowing hanging bone pillars, then to a warm spiral shaft of bone terraces in the centre. Lower centre: a dark lake with floating grey mats. Right of it, two tiny tents under a fold of bone. Further right, rows of white rib arches, then a sharp bend between reddish membrane walls near the right edge, and in the upper right, in the head, a white lattice on thin branches over a dark hollow. A second, narrower route returns west along the upper half: a chute between grinding bone walls, a small dry pocket with three crawlways, and near the top centre a narrow crack where one blade of daylight falls in. Chambers grow darker towards the head; torchlit amber against bone ivory. No people, no lettering.

Draw every place described above as a small, clearly recognisable landmark exactly at its stated position, with the roads, paths, corridors or waterways between them visible, so that markers can later be pinned on each landmark. Fill the whole picture edge to edge with the mapped land (no border, no frame, no cartouche, no legend, no compass rose, no scale bar, no grid). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels or symbols that read as letters anywhere on the map. No people, no creatures, no figures.

The attached image is this campaign's cover: match its painting technique, palette, light and mood, but not its composition.

Match one consistent house style: original premium illustrated dark fantasy for adults, painterly gouache and oil with heavy textured brushwork and charcoal ink lines, crisp readable silhouettes, deep chiaroscuro lit by torches and bioluminescent marrow glow; palette of bone ivory and old yellowed white, salt grey, dried-blood rust and deep marrow red, torch amber, with near-black umber shadows. Dread, awe and endurance; unsettling organic architecture of bone and sinew but no gore, no open wounds, no corpses shown in detail, no horror-movie jump scare, no franchise references, no anime look, no photorealism. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border.
